reference: Never had we seen a group this quiet at sunset.
sk: Nikdy predtým sme nevideli takú tichú skupinu pri západe slnka.
cz: Nikdy předtím jsme neviděli tak tichou skupinu při západu slunce.
acceptable: Never {before |}had we seen {a group this quiet|a group so quiet|such a quiet group} at sunset.
Never {before |}have we seen {a group this quiet|a group so quiet|such a quiet group} at sunset.

mistakes.text: Never we had seen {a group this quiet|such a quiet group} at sunset.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „Never“ na začiatku vety treba inverziu: „Never had we seen“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „Never“ na začátku věty je potřeba inverze: „Never had we seen“.
mistakes.feedback_en: When a sentence starts with “Never”, invert subject and auxiliary: “Never had we seen”.

mistakes.text: We had never seen {a group this quiet|such a quiet group} at sunset {before|}.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Cvičí sa inverzia: začni „Never had we seen…“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Procvičuje se inverze: začni „Never had we seen…“.
mistakes.feedback_en: This exercise practises inversion: start with “Never had we seen…”.

mistakes.text: Never had we not seen {a group this quiet|such a quiet group} at sunset.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Never“ už je zápor, „not“ sem nepatrí: „Never had we seen“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Never“ už je zápor, „not“ sem nepatří: „Never had we seen“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Never” is already negative, so drop “not”: “Never had we seen”.

mistakes.text: Never had we saw {a group this quiet|such a quiet group} at sunset.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “had” use the past participle: “seen”, not “saw”.

mistakes.text: Never did we see {a group this quiet|such a quiet group} at sunset.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri skúsenosti do určitého bodu je prirodzenejší Past Perfect: „Never had we seen“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U zkušenosti do určitého okamžiku je přirozenější Past Perfect: „Never had we seen“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For experience up to a point in the past, the Past Perfect is more natural: “Never had we seen”.

mistakes.text: Never had we seen so quiet group at sunset.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pred podstatným menom patrí „such a quiet group“ alebo „a group so quiet“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Před podstatným jménem patří „such a quiet group“ nebo „a group so quiet“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Before an adjective + noun use “such a quiet group” or “a group so quiet”.

source_issues: Slovak/Czech past tense with 'nikdy predtým/předtím' also allows Present Perfect ('Never before have we seen'); accepted.
